app.title: Stitches on Fire
info.title: About
info.brief: Stitches on Fire is a mobile-first crochet chart editor. Design, edit, and export crochet patterns, entirely offline.
help.title: Help
help.element.menu: Open the menu to save your pattern, start a new one, export it, open a saved pattern, or see this help.
help.element.name: Tap here to give your pattern a name.
help.element.language: Switch the app to a different language.
help.element.menuSave: Saves your pattern so you can come back to it later.
help.element.menuExport: Saves your chart as a PDF you can print or share.
help.element.menuPatterns: Your saved patterns — tap one to open it, or tap Delete to remove it.
help.element.toolAdd: Adds stitches. Pick a stitch below, then tap or drag across the chart to place it.
help.element.toolSelect: Selects stitches, so you can change their color, thread, side, or other settings.
help.element.toolDelete: Removes stitches. Tap, or drag across, the stitches you want gone.
help.element.toolMove: Changes the order stitches were worked in, without moving them on the chart.
help.element.redo: Redoes a change you just undid.
help.element.stitchButton: Pick a stitch type here, then use the Add tool to place it. Tap and hold to see its name.
help.element.moreStitches: Choose which stitch types show in the row above, or pick a different look for a stitch.
help.element.colorPicker: Picks the color new stitches will be added in.
help.element.guideToggle: Shows or hides the light grid of dots that helps you line up stitches. Tap and hold to adjust how bright it is.
help.element.sequenceToggle: Shows or hides the line tracing the order you worked your stitches in. Tap and hold to adjust its brightness.
help.element.sideContrastToggle: Fades stitches worked on the back, so the two sides are easy to tell apart. Tap and hold to adjust the fade.
help.element.zoom: Zooms your chart in or out.
help.element.resetView: Fits your whole chart back on the screen.
help.element.side: Marks whether the selected stitches are on the front or back of your work.
help.element.marker: Puts a small marker dot on the selected stitches — handy for flagging a spot to come back to.
help.element.thread: Picks which thread or yarn the selected stitches use. Tap and hold to rename a thread or change its color.
help.element.layer: Picks which layer the selected stitches belong to — useful for charts with more than one piece. Tap and hold for layer settings.
help.element.canvas: Your chart. Tap, drag, or pinch to move around and zoom.
help.howto.addStitches.title: Add your first stitches
help.howto.addStitches.step1: Pick a stitch type from the row at the bottom of the screen.
help.howto.addStitches.step2: Make sure the Add tool is selected — it usually is by default.
help.howto.addStitches.step3: Tap, or drag your finger, across the chart to place stitches.
help.howto.changeLanguage.title: Switch the app's language
help.howto.changeLanguage.step1: Tap the flag in the top-right corner.
help.howto.changeLanguage.step2: Pick your language from the list that opens.
help.howto.savePattern.title: Save your pattern and find it again
help.howto.savePattern.step1: Tap the menu icon in the top-left corner.
help.howto.savePattern.step3: To reopen it later, open the menu again and tap its name under your saved patterns.
help.howto.exportPdf.title: Print or share your chart
help.howto.exportPdf.step2: Tap Export to save your chart as a PDF.
help.howto.undoMistake.title: Undo a mistake
help.howto.undoMistake.step1: Tap the curved arrow in the tool row to undo your last change.
help.howto.undoMistake.step2: Tap the other curved arrow to redo it, if you change your mind.
help.howto.markSides.title: Tell front and back stitches apart
help.howto.markSides.step1: Select one or more stitches with the Select tool.
help.howto.markSides.step2: Tap the side button to mark them front or back.
help.howto.markSides.step3: Turn on the fade toggle to see both sides at a glance.
